record.question: In COPD patients receiving supplemental oxygen, which oxygen saturation range helps prevent CO2 retention while ensuring adequate oxygenation?
record.explanation: Answer C: 88–92%. For patients with COPD at risk of hypercapnic respiratory failure, controlled oxygen is generally titrated to a target saturation of 88–92% pending blood-gas results. Source/context note: Not every person with COPD requires this target; use prescribed targets and blood gases. Reference: https://www.brit-thoracic.org.uk/quality-improvement/guidelines/emergency-oxygen/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
